import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_86/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_86/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_86/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_86/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_86/training_4.csv"
]

# Columns of the target schema with expected types
target_columns = ['titulo', 'tipo', 'precio', 'condicion', 'ubicacion', 'tiempo', 'reputacion', 'pago']

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema
    df = df[target_columns].copy()
    # Convert 'precio' to float (some sources have int or string)
    df['precio'] = pd.to_numeric(df['precio'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # Convert all other columns to string (object) to match target schema
    for col in target_columns:
        if col != 'precio':
            df[col] = df[col].astype(str).replace({'nan': pd.NA})
    dfs.append(df)

# Operation History: UNION all source tables
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_86/target_multisource.csv"
target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
